children: Singhal joins from GMR Airports with over four decades of experience across infrastructure projects in India and international markets

Hindustan Construction Company (HCC) has appointed Vivek Singhal as its Chief Executive Officer, effective 5 November 2026. He joins the company with more than four decades of experience across infrastructure and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC), spanning project execution, business leadership, business development and profit and loss (P&L) management.

Singhal has spent 16 years working in international markets, where he has delivered projects and managed assets worth approximately Rs 28,500 crore across five countries. His experience covers several infrastructure segments, including airports, metro rail, urban transport, hydropower and bridges.He joins HCC from GMR Airports Ltd., Singapore, where he served as Chief Executive Officer. In that role, he oversaw global strategy, P&L management, business development and airport asset development across international markets.

Before his stint at GMR Airports, Singhal held senior leadership positions at Tata Projects, GMR Group in the Maldives, Alpine Bau GmbH in Singapore and Larsen & Toubro (L&T).At Tata Projects, he led the urban infrastructure business, growing its turnover from inception to more than Rs 73,300 crore, with an order backlog exceeding Rs 3,80,000 crore.

During his tenure at Alpine Bau, he led major underground metro projects in Singapore with a combined contract value of more than US$1 billion.Commenting on the appointment, Arjun Dhawan, Vice Chairman and Managing Director of HCC, said Singhal's experience in building and managing large infrastructure businesses across domestic and international markets would strengthen the company's leadership.

“Vivek has built and run large infrastructure businesses across India and international markets and has delivered at scale. That depth will strengthen HCC's leadership as we build on our engineering and execution capabilities and enter our next phase of growth,” Dhawan said.Singhal holds a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, Allahabad. He has also completed the Advanced Management Programme at IIM Bangalore and is a Fellow of the Institution of Civil Engineers, UK.
